title: Cross-process D3D11 shared-texture virtual-camera handoff
hardware: Windows 11 Pro build 26300; 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13700H; Intel Iris Xe Graphics; driver 32.0.101.7092

gates.adapter: hardware Intel Iris Xe; software adapters rejected
gates.output: exactly 1000 NV12 1920x1080 frames with strictly increasing sequence markers and zero payload marker errors
gates.recovery: producer kill/restart and 30-second stall recover without reinstall or client hang
gates.applications: OBS and Tencent Meeting separately receive valid 1080p30 output and each pass a 10-minute soak

verdict.scope: The interactive Iris Xe producer and out-of-process Frame Server source allocator exposed different adapter LUIDs, so the required same-adapter D3D11 NT shared-texture handoff failed before any frame delivery. Conditional recovery, application, and soak checks were not run.
